items.title: Zerostack – A Unix-inspired coding agent written in pure Rust
items.author: gidellav
items.summary: Zerostack is a Unix-inspired coding agent written in pure Rust. It's a lightweight, terminal-based tool for AI coding. It reduces LLM token consumption by up to 90%.

items.title: MCP Hello Page
items.author: Dachande663
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard for connecting AI applications to external systems. MCP enables AI tools to interact with data sources and workflows. It is not specific to any single AI system.

items.title: SANA-WM, a 2.6B open-source world model for 1-minute 720p video
items.author: mjgil
items.summary: SANA-WM is a 2.6B-parameter open-source world model generating 1-minute 720p videos with precise 6-DoF camera control. It runs efficiently on a single GPU and consumer hardware like RTX 5090.

items.title: OpenAI and Government of Malta partner to roll out ChatGPT Plus to all citizens
items.author: bookofjoe
items.summary: OpenAI partnered with the Government of Malta to provide free access to ChatGPT Plus for all citizens who complete an AI literacy course. This initiative aims to integrate AI into daily life for Maltese families, students, and workers. This partnership is part of a broader global initiative by OpenAI.

items.title: Moving away from Tailwind, and learning to structure my CSS
items.author: mpweiher
items.summary: Transitioning from Tailwind to structured CSS involves using CSS variables for scalable font sizes and spacing. Focus on semantic HTML and vanilla CSS for better control. Consider CSS resets for consistent baseline styles.

items.title: Accelerando (2005)
items.author: eamag
items.summary: Accelerando is a 2005 science fiction novel by Charles Stross, consisting of interconnected short stories about a family through a technological singularity. It won the Locus Award for Best Science Fiction Novel in 2006.

items.title: Frontier AI has broken the open CTF format
items.author: frays
items.summary: Frontier AI has rendered traditional open CTF competitions ineffective, as models like GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 can now solve most challenges quickly. This has led to calls for CTF organizers to adopt private or hardware-bound formats. The trend shows AI's growing dominance in traditional hacking competitions.

items.title: We've made the world too complicated
items.author: James72689
items.summary: The world's complexity has increased due to technological advancements, leading to challenges in understanding and managing it. Despite this, complexity often brings benefits like problem-solving and wealth creation. The modern world's intricate systems can be overwhelming.

items.title: δ-mem: Efficient Online Memory for Large Language Models
items.author: 44za12
items.summary: δ-mem is a memory mechanism for large language models that uses a compact online state to provide low-rank corrections to attention computations without full fine-tuning. It improves performance by compressing past information into a fixed-size state matrix. The method achieves better results than frozen backbones and non-δ-mem baselines.

items.title: Nearly 50 Years Later, WKRP in Cincinnati Becomes a Real Radio Station
items.author: bookofjoe
items.summary: Nearly 50 years after the sitcom, a Cincinnati radio station rebranded as "WKRP in Cincinnati," adopting the fictional station's call letters and format. The station is now playing nostalgic rock music. This move has excited longtime fans of the original show.

items.title: Futhark by example (2020)
items.author: tosh
items.summary: Futhark is a GPU functional programming language introduced in 2020. It includes examples like the factorial function and is used for projects like ray tracing and cryptographic hash functions. Its examples are available on its official website.

items.title: I believe there are entire companies right now under AI psychosis
items.author: reasonableklout
items.summary: Many companies are heavily investing in AI, leading to widespread enthusiasm and sometimes over-exuberance in the industry. This phenomenon is often referred to as "AI psychosis." This trend is evident in 2026.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash means LLM steering is interesting again
items.author: Brajeshwar
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash makes LLM steering practical. It allows guiding LLM outputs by manipulating model activations. This approach is now accessible for many engineers.

items.title: HTML Lists
items.author: speckx
items.summary: HTML lists include unordered lists, ordered lists, and description lists, using tags like <ul>, <ol>, and <dl> to organize content clearly. Unordered lists use <li> for bullet points, while ordered lists use <li> with numbers. Description lists pair terms with descriptions using <dt> and <dd>.

items.title: Japan’s robot wolf sells out as record bear attacks drive demand
items.author: bookofjoe
items.summary: Japan's animatronic "Monster Wolf" sells out due to record bear attacks; Ohta Seiki struggles to meet demand; device emits sounds and moves to scare animals.

items.title: Gaining control of every projector and camera on campus
items.author: ednaordinary
items.summary: Authorized users can remotely control every projector and camera on campus through the campus network, using connected devices. This system allows for efficient management and monitoring of AV equipment. This capability is available to those with proper authorization.

items.title: The main thing about P2P meth is that there's so much of it (2021)
items.author: tomjakubowski
items.summary: P2P meth became prevalent due to its easy synthesis from widely available chemicals, leading to increased availability and addiction rates. It differs chemically from older meth, potentially causing more severe effects. The rise of P2P meth began around 2017.

items.title: Naturally Occurring Quasicrystals
items.author: lukeplato
items.summary: Naturally occurring quasicrystals were first discovered in the Koryak mountains in Russia, specifically the mineral icosahedrite. This discovery expanded the known types of natural structures, proving quasicrystals can form under geological conditions. The finding was published in the American Mineralogist.

items.title: My Favorite Bugs: Invalid Surrogate Pairs
items.author: meysamazad
items.summary: Invalid surrogate pairs in UTF-16 cause errors in encoding, as they are not standalone code points. They can lead to syntax errors in languages like Ruby. Proper handling is crucial to avoid unexpected behavior.
